transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Yeah, nice to meet you too. Um, I guess what brings me in is that I keep getting these... flashes. They just hit me completely out of nowhere. 

It's like I'm right back in this crowded holding room. I keep seeing this fight happen and hearing everybody get shoved up against the wall. And it happens at the most random times, like... even when I'm just standing at a pickup counter for work, waiting for a package. It just takes over, and I needed to get some help for it.
During that event in the holding room, did you believe that you or someone else might be seriously hurt or killed?

Um, I'm not really sure. It all just happened so fast. Like, one second I was just standing there, and the next it was just complete chaos. So... I don't know if I actually thought someone was going to get killed or seriously hurt right in that exact moment. I just remember people getting slammed into the wall and just trying to stay out of the way, you know? I didn't really have time to think about it like that.
When these flashes happen, do you feel detached from yourself or like the world around you isn’t real?

Um, no, not really. I don't feel disconnected from myself or anything like that. I mean, I still know who I am and where I am when it happens. It's just that the memory kind of forces its way in and takes over for a minute. But the world around me still feels real. I just haven't really noticed feeling detached like that.
When one of these flashes hits, do you suddenly get an intense surge of fear or panic?

Um, no, I wouldn't say I get a surge of panic. It's more just... being startled by the memory itself, I guess? Like, my heart might beat a little faster because I wasn't expecting to see it again, but I don't feel terrified or like I'm having a panic attack. It's just really distracting and upsetting when it interrupts my day.
How long have these flashes been happening since the incident in the holding room?
It's been going on for about a week now. Pretty much ever since I was detained overnight and... saw that assault happen in the holding area.
Since that night, have you been avoiding reminders of the holding room or the assault?

Yeah, I have. I've actually... I've been turning down night runs for work, and I take the long way around town now. I just can't make myself go anywhere near that detention building. And I really try not to talk about what happened, either, because... well, if I do, it just feels like I'm right back there in that room.
Has it been a full month or more since that night in the holding room?
No, it hasn't been a month. Like I said, it's only been about a week since the whole thing happened... since I got detained and had to see all that.
During what happened in the holding room, did you think that you or someone else might die or be seriously injured?

I... I'm not really sure. I don't remember specifically thinking that someone was going to die, or... or how bad the injuries would be. It all just happened so fast, and it was pretty violent. I think I was just frozen, you know? So I can't really tell you exactly what was going through my head at that exact moment.
During the assault in the holding room, did you believe that you yourself were in immediate danger of being seriously injured?

I don't know if I thought about it like that. I mean, I was definitely scared, but I don't remember thinking specifically that they were going to turn on me and hurt me. I was just trying to stay out of the way and not draw any attention to myself.
While you were in that holding room, did you believe the person being assaulted might be seriously injured or killed?

I don't... I don't really know. Like I said, it was all just so violent and fast. I wasn't really analyzing it or thinking about how bad it could get for him. I just knew it was bad, and I was terrified. I wasn't really processing if he was going to die or anything like that.
Did you actually see the person being assaulted get seriously injured?

I didn't actually see the injuries themselves. I mean, I saw them hitting him, but... I couldn't really see the damage they were doing. I couldn't see if he was bleeding or if bones were breaking or anything like that. I just saw the assault happening, the hitting and kicking. So, no, I didn't see a specific serious injury happen to him.
At the time, did it seem to you that the person being assaulted could be seriously hurt or killed?

I mean, that's kind of what I was just trying to say. I wasn't really thinking about it in those terms. It didn't specifically cross my mind that he could be killed or how bad the injuries would be. I just knew it was a really violent situation and I was scared. I wasn't really analyzing what the end result was going to be for him while it was happening.
While you were in the holding room, did anyone physically attack you or directly threaten to seriously hurt or kill you?
No, they didn't. No one touched me or... or said anything to me at all. They were entirely focused on him the whole time. So, no, I wasn't attacked or threatened myself.
